yourWriting.heading: Writing
yourWriting.intro: See how each story is doing, pick up your drafts and read what readers said.

empty.title: No stories yet
empty.description: Start a story and write chapter one. Only you can see it until you publish.

yourWriting.onlyYou: Only you can see this story until you publish its first chapter.
yourWriting.created: Your story is saved. Only you can see it until you publish its first chapter.

newStory.heading: Start a new story
newStory.intro: Fill in the basics, then write chapter one. You can change this later in story settings.
newStory.title: Title
newStory.blurbHint: One or two sentences: who the story is about and what happens. {{count}} of {{max}} characters.
newStory.languageHint: Choose the language your story is written in. More languages open once we have moderators who read them.
newStory.tagsHint: {{count}} of {{max}} tags. Separate them with commas. Capital letters and diacritics don’t matter, and a tag typed in another language becomes its name in yours. A new tag shows to readers once our team approves it.
newStory.tagsFull: {{max}} of {{max}} tags. Remove one to add another.
newStory.rights: Your work stays yours. You keep the rights and can publish it anywhere. Only you can see this story until you publish its first chapter.
newStory.notActive: Your account can’t create stories yet. Confirm your email and choose a username, or wait for the test to open to your age group.
newStory.createFailed: We couldn’t save your story. Check your connection and try again.
newStory.signedOut: Log in to start a story.
newStory.languageComing: {{language}}: coming when we have moderators for it

cover.heading: Cover
cover.previewLabel: Cover preview: {{design}}, {{background}} background with {{accent}} {{part}}. Title {{title}}, by {{penName}}.
cover.pickBackground: Pick a background. We add your title and pen name.
cover.accentNotePlain: On a plain background this colours the line under the title.
cover.accentNoteTwotone: On Two-tone this colours the bottom band with the title.
cover.autoContrast: We choose dark or light text for you, so your title is always easy to read.
cover.drawnNote: A drawn cover needs no picture rights and shows straight away.

automatic.intro: Skip this and we’ll give your story one of these covers automatically. You can change it any time.
automatic.current: Right now: {{design}}, picked for you automatically.

cover.uploadLater: Want to use your own picture? Save the story first, then upload it in the story's settings.
cover.uploadChosen: Your uploaded picture is the cover. Pick a drawn design below to use that instead.

preview.deleteLater: You can also delete the story later in story settings. We ask twice, hide it straight away and delete it for good after 30 days. Until then you can undo it.

errors.titleTooLong: A title can have at most 120 characters.
errors.blurbTooLong: A blurb can have at most 500 characters.
errors.languageMissing: Choose the language your story is written in.
errors.tagTooLong: A tag can have at most 40 characters.
errors.tooManyTags: A story can have at most 10 tags.
errors.duplicateTag: Two of these tags are the same once we ignore capitals and diacritics.
errors.loadFailed: We couldn’t load this page. Check your connection and try again.
errors.storyIdInvalid: The story could not be given an ID. Reload the page and try again.
errors.abuseNeedsRating: A story about abuse or coercion must be rated 16+ or 18+.
errors.abuseNeedsNote: Add a content note for a story about abuse or coercion.
errors.contentNoteTooLong: A content note can have at most {{max}} characters.
errors.chapterCreateFailed: The story was saved, but we couldn’t open chapter one. Open it from Writing.
errors.ratingReasonsMissing: Tick at least one reason why it is 16+ or 18+.

status.heading: Status and comments
status.label: Status
status.hint: Shown on your story card. Readers can filter by it.

hints.public: Anyone can find it in Discover, search, tags and on your profile.
hints.unlisted: Only people with the link can read it. It isn’t in Discover, search, tags or on your profile. People who saved or follow it keep it.
hints.private: Only you can read it, even after you publish chapters. Nobody is told about new chapters.

readOn.heading: Where people can read it
readOn.label: Where can people read this story?

options.web_and_app: On the web and in the app

hints.web_and_app: Readers open the chapters on the web and in the app.
hints.app_only: On the web readers see the cover, blurb and chapter list. The chapters open in the app, where they are harder to copy.

readOn.notYet: The {{productName}} apps aren’t out yet. Until they are, everyone who’s logged in reads every chapter on the web, and we’ll tell you before “In the app only” starts to apply.

comments.label: Comments
comments.on: On. Readers can comment on every chapter.
comments.off: Off. Existing comments are hidden and nobody can add new ones.

quoteCards.label: Quote cards and passage links
quoteCards.on: On. Readers can turn a short passage into a picture to share, one per chapter, and share a link that opens the chapter at a passage.
quoteCards.off: Off. Readers can still share a link to a chapter, but not a quote card or a link to a passage.

pictureSharing.label: Sharing pictures
pictureSharing.on: On. Readers can share a picture from your chapters as a card with your name and a link to it. Only pictures that passed the check.
pictureSharing.off: Off. Readers can’t share the chapters’ pictures.

cardColour.label: Colour for quote and picture cards
cardColour.hint: New cards readers make from your story start in this colour. Each reader can still pick another for their own card.

settings.heading: Story settings
settings.saveFailed: We couldn’t save the changes. Check your connection and try again.
settings.notFound: We can’t find this story on this account.
settings.intro: Change anything here. Readers see the changes as soon as you save.

deleteStory.heading: Delete this story
deleteStory.intro: We ask you twice. The story and all its chapters are hidden straight away and deleted for good after 30 days.
deleteStory.lastCheckBody: We hide the story now and delete it for good on {{date}}. You can undo until then.
deleteStory.deleted: Story deleted. It’s hidden from readers and will be gone for good on {{date}}.

recentlyDeleted.heading: Recently deleted
recentlyDeleted.intro: Deleted stories are hidden straight away and deleted for good after 30 days. Until then you can undo.

labels.heading: Labels
labels.intro: Labels show on your story card and story page. If your story is fan fiction or a parody, you must tick it.
labels.fanFictionHint: It uses characters or a world from someone else’s book, film, game or show.
labels.parodyHint: It copies another work on purpose to make fun of it or comment on it.
labels.abuseHint: Abuse, coercion or grooming is a theme of the story. It then needs the 16+ or 18+ rating and a content note.
labels.contentNoteHint: A short warning readers see before they open the story. {{count}} of {{max}} characters.
labels.ratingNoteAllAges: Anyone can find and read it. Pick 13+, 16+ or 18+ if your story isn’t right for younger readers; it’s then hidden from anyone younger.
labels.ratingNoteHidden: Hidden from anyone under {{age}}, in search, on Discover and on your profile. Readers see the rating before they open the story.
labels.ratingUnderSixteen: Writers under 16 can rate a story All ages or 13+.

all_ages.who: For everyone, children included: written like a children’s book
all_ages.what: Feelings and friendships, a first kiss at most. Nothing frightening shown in detail, no swearing.

13_plus.what: Crushes, relationships and kisses between characters of any age, 16 and 17-year-olds included, with no sexual content. Mild swearing, fights and scary moments.

16_plus.what: Darker themes such as abuse, self-harm or war, told with care and a content note. Sex between adult characters can be mentioned, never described.

18_plus.what: Strong violence, strong language and sexual content between adult characters.

labels.guideRule: At every rating: no sexual content involving anyone under 18, real or fictional. Not sure? Pick the higher rating; our team can change it if a reader reports it.
labels.aiHint: Shown as a label on your story. If someone reports a missing label, a person on our team decides. We never use AI detectors to judge your writing.

manageChapters.heading: Manage chapters
manageChapters.intro: Change the order, rename, unpublish or delete chapters. Readers see changes straight away.
manageChapters.note: Drag a chapter, or use the arrows. Moving a published chapter asks first.
manageChapters.dragLabel: Drag chapter {{number}} to reorder. You can also use the arrows.

meta.unpublishedNote: readers can’t open it · comments hidden but kept

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
deleteDialog.body: We hide it from readers straight away and delete it for good after 30 days. Until then you can undo it under Recently deleted.

deleted.heading: Recently deleted
deleted.intro: Deleted chapters are hidden straight away and deleted for good after 30 days. Until then you can undo.
deleted.empty: Nothing deleted in the last 30 days.

problems.notActive: Your account can’t change chapters yet. Confirm your email and choose a username first.
problems.empty: This chapter has no words yet, so it can’t be published. Open it and write something first.
problems.outOfDate: Something changed on another device or tab. The list is up to date now; try again.
problems.failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection and try again.

drag.instructions: To move a chapter, focus its handle and press Space. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it, Space again to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
drag.cancelled: Move cancelled. {{title}} stays where it was.

moveDialog.title: Move a published chapter?
moveDialog.body: “{{title}}” becomes chapter {{number}}. Readers see the new numbers at once, and their saved places stay with the chapters.

rankBadges.intro: Your cover shows where the story stands in its tags, like “#4 in Fantasy”, counted the same way as the tag pages. It shows the 3 best ranks unless you pick up to 3 tags here. A tag shows a rank once the story has readers and the tag holds a few stories.
rankBadges.full: You've picked 3. Switch one off to pick another.
rankBadges.noTags: Approved tags appear here once you save the story with tags.
rankBadges.saved: Saved. Readers see the new badges within a few minutes.
rankBadges.saveFailed: The badges couldn't be saved. Try again in a moment.

dashboard.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your numbers. Refresh the page to try again.

totals.heading: How readers respond
totals.readsLast30: Chapter openings in the last 30 days
totals.readThroughNote: Share of readers who got to the end
totals.privacy: You never see which readers opened a chapter. Any number that comes from fewer than 5 readers shows as “fewer than 5”, so nobody can be picked out.

followers.chartLabel: New followers per week, last 8 weeks: {{values}}
followers.note: New followers each week. Weeks start on Monday.

notPublished.heading: Not published yet
notPublished.empty: Nothing waiting: every chapter is out.

table.regionLabel: Numbers per chapter for {{title}}. Scroll sideways on small screens.
table.caption: Per chapter, all time. Read-through is the share of readers who got to the end of the chapter.

comments.heading: Latest on the chapters
comments.empty: No comments yet. They appear here when readers write under your chapters.

canva.heading: Design it in Canva
canva.signedOut: Log in first, then press “Design it in Canva” again in your story’s settings.
canva.working: One moment. We’re talking to Canva…
canva.cancelled: You didn’t connect Canva, so nothing was shared with Canva. You can try again any time from your story’s settings.
canva.savedChecking: You can see it now. Readers see it once it has been checked. That takes a few minutes, or up to two days when a person on our moderation team looks at it. You can close this tab.
canva.savedVisible: Readers can see it now. You can close this tab.
canva.note: Canva opens a blank cover at the right size. When you press Return in Canva, your cover comes back here. You need your own Canva account, and Canva’s rules apply there. Nothing is shared with Canva until you connect.

failed.switched_off: Designing covers in Canva is switched off right now.
failed.account: This account can’t change covers right now.
failed.not_connected: Canva isn’t connected any more. Press “Design it in Canva” again in your story’s settings to connect it.
failed.declined: Canva didn’t accept the connection. Try again from the story’s settings.
failed.expired: This link has expired or didn’t come from Canva. Start again from the story’s settings.
failed.export_failed: Canva couldn’t export your design. Open it in Canva and press Return again.
failed.unavailable: Canva isn’t set up yet. Try again later.
failed.unreachable: We couldn’t reach Canva or our server. Check your connection and try again.
failed.signed_out: Log in first, then try again.
failed.invalid: This page only works on the way to Canva and back. Start from your story’s settings.
failed.storyNotFound: We couldn’t find that story on this account.

settings.heading: Canva
settings.notConnected: Not connected. You connect Canva the first time you press “Design it in Canva” in a story’s cover settings.
settings.connected: Connected since {{date}}. We use it only to open blank covers and bring back the ones you design.
settings.disconnectFailed: We couldn’t disconnect Canva. Try again.
settings.loadFailed: We couldn’t check whether Canva is connected. Try again.

canva.arrived: Your new cover from Canva is here, and it’s already saved.

insights.heading: Lines and stops
insights.intro: Totals from readers’ shared passages, paragraph comments and saved places. Never who.
insights.lovedEmpty: No shared passages or paragraph comments on this chapter yet.
insights.stopsIntro: Where readers’ saved places are, in tenths of the chapter. The last tenth includes readers who reached the end.
insights.stopsFewer: Fewer than 5 readers have a saved place in this chapter, so there is no bar yet.
insights.loadFailed: We couldn’t load these numbers. Refresh the page to try again.

allComments.heading: Comments on the chapters
allComments.lead: What readers wrote under each published chapter, newest first.
allComments.loadFailed: The comments couldn’t load. Check your connection and try again.
